props.text:
BTC technical setup + FOMC macro timing:

Near-term bearish: Rejected 365d RVWAP, RSI lower high, bull trap closed, longs trapped >80k. Weekend breakout attempts = obvious bait for short hedging.

Catalysts (next 2 weeks):
- Sept 11: CPI
- Sept 16: FOMC

Rate hike odds: 58% (CME), 50% (Polymarket) — back on table after being priced out.

Strategy: "Warsh does it, hike odds 99.5% by FOMC, thats where you go ultimate long when the hike is done. Should be the only and last one."

⚠️ Alts/onchain = very dangerous spot now.

Invalidation: Strong close >82k

Macro timing: Bearish into FOMC → Ultimate long post-hike.
